description: Reads up to about thirty public pages of a public GitHub repository and reports which of eight security signals are visible: a security policy that names a contact or a reporting link, a software bill of materials, proof of where releases come from, a lockfile, automatic updates of dependencies, security scans in CI, recent maintenance and a licence. For each signal that is not visible the answer says what would make it visible; a signal that could not be read completely is marked not measured, never as a gap. The eight signals are a selection related to topics in the EU Cyber Resilience Act. This is an indication from public data, not a compliance check, not a certificate and not legal advice; private repositories and hosts other than GitHub cannot be checked. Read only. Limited to a few checks per ten minutes per address.

repo.description: A public GitHub repository as owner/name, or its https://github.com/owner/name address

name: check_github_repo
title: Check a public GitHub repository for eight CRA-related security signals
